about.title: About SmartPDF Notes
about.description1: SmartPDF Notes is a platform created to help students and professionals save time and learn more efficiently. Using artificial intelligence, our application generates summaries, tests and quizzes from PDFs.
about.description2: Our mission is to make learning more accessible and interactive through technology. With flexible plans and innovative functionalities, we want to transform the way users interact with study materials.
about.description3: SmartPDF Notes is developed with passion and dedication by a team of young innovators, with the goal of bringing real value to education.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: At SmartPDF Notes, user privacy is a priority. We are committed to protecting your personal information.
privacy.point1: We collect only the data strictly necessary to provide services.
privacy.point2: PDF file data is not shared and is processed securely.
privacy.point3: We do not sell, rent or distribute personal information to third parties.
privacy.point4: We use cookies only to improve the user experience.
privacy.point5: Each user has the right to request deletion of their personal data.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: This application uses cookies to ensure an optimal user experience.
cookies.point1: We use cookies for authentication, language preferences and traffic analysis.
cookies.point2: Cookies do not contain personally identifiable information.
cookies.point3: You can choose to disable cookies from your browser settings, but some functionality may be affected.
cookies.point4: By continuing to use the platform, you agree to our cookie policy.
